latest_release.name: Leantime v3.13.2
latest_release.body:
# Version: 3.13.2

## New Features
- **Marketplace install reporting** - Plugin installations now report their results and server details back to the marketplace (#3979)
- **Email digest: "New" and "Already seen"** - Notifications already read in the inbox move under an "Already seen" heading, and a digest with nothing new is no longer sent (#3986)
- **Company email frequency is a floor** - The company setting no longer overrides a person's own choice; people can make email quieter for themselves, but not more frequent than the company setting (#3986)

## Bug Fixes
- **Top loader clears after Save & Close** - The loading indicator no longer stays active after using Save & Close in a modal (#3984)
- **Resume owner setup during install** - The /install flow can now resume owner setup even after the post-install redirect is lost (#3983)
- **Correct calendar event times** - Event times now follow the user's current time format instead of a stale session copy (#3982)
- **More reliable OIDC login** - OIDC authentication now sends PKCE and displays provider errors instead of crashing the callback (#3981)
- **User named on delete confirmation** - The delete confirmation page now shows the name of the user being removed (#3980)

---


<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 3c0258a3cf8aeda6b365f1e34443358da65f9fda -->

## What's Changed
### Other Changes
* feat(plugins): report marketplace install results and server details to the marketplace by @marcelfolaron in https://github.com/Leantime/leantime/pull/3979
* fix(users): name the user on the delete confirmation page by @marcelfolaron in https://github.com/Leantime/leantime/pull/3980
* fix(oidc): send PKCE and show provider errors instead of crashing the callback by @marcelfolaron in https://github.com/Leantime/leantime/pull/3981
* fix(calendar): event times follow the user's/language time format, not a stale session copy by @marcelfolaron in https://github.com/Leantime/leantime/pull/3982
* fix(install): let /install resume an owner setup the post-install redirect lost by @marcelfolaron in https://github.com/Leantime/leantime/pull/3983
* fix(ui): top loader no longer stays active after Save & Close in a modal by @marcelfolaron in https://github.com/Leantime/leantime/pull/3984
* feat(notifications): email digest splits "New" from "Already seen"; company email frequency becomes a floor by @gloriafolaron in https://github.com/Leantime/leantime/pull/3986
* Release v3.13.2 by @marcelfolaron in https://github.com/Leantime/leantime/pull/3987


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Leantime/leantime/compare/v3.13.1...v3.13.2

# Leantime® ⭐ If you find Leantime useful, please star us on GitHub! ⭐ Leantime is an open source project management system for non-project managers.
We combine strategy, planning and execution while making it easy for everyone on the team to use.
Built with ADHD, dyslexia and autism in mind. 🧠
💪 As simple as Trello but as feature-rich as Jira
🔄 A perfect alternative to ClickUp, Monday, or Asana
